product.title: Premium Oahu Circle Island Tour – Small Group, No Crowds

description.text: This small-group circle-island tour of Oahu is ideal for those who want to see a lot in a short time. In a cozy vehicle with no more than 14 passengers, you'll see landmarks like Diamond Head, the Halona Blowhole, Nu'uanu Pali Lookout, and historic Haleiwa Town. You'll also visit the famed Dole Plantation where you'll get a whole delicious Dole pineapple. Ideal for travelers basing in Honolulu who want a guided Oahu experience without coordinating transport, gear, or admission tickets on their own.
